title: 第2538章 让自己人去消费第2537章 教育赵玉霖
content_zh:
赵玉霖虽然魂力很弱，但悟性很高。
不到一刻钟，过去从未用过储物戒的他就看到了储物戒内空间，激动的喊了起来：“师尊，徒儿看到您给徒儿的东西了。”
“用意念尝试着拿出来。”
陆宸说。
“好！”
赵玉霖乖巧的说，又尝试起来。
片刻时间，他就拿出了一些小东西，但那些有着一两斤重的东西就拿不出来了。
赵玉霖撤去感知，不解的问道：“师尊，为什么那些大的东西徒儿拿不出来？”
“因为你的魂力实在太弱了。”
陆宸说。
“那徒儿要怎么才能提升自己的魂力？”
赵玉霖问。
“修炼魂诀！”
说着，陆宸把天魂经、体经和一种名为斗战圣诀的苍灵级功法交给赵玉霖。
伴随着一道光芒进入赵玉霖识海，赵玉霖很快就在自己的脑袋里想到了这三种功法。
“天魂经、体经、斗战圣诀！”
赵玉霖喃喃自语，被彻底吸引。
陆宸道：“小霖，在接下来的时间里，你就用为师给你的资源先提升魂力修为。”
赵玉霖道：“师尊，不先提升武道吗？”
陆宸笑道：“先提升魂力，武道放一放，有为师在，短时间内没有什么人能伤到你。”

“好！”
赵玉霖笑着应下。
之后，陆宸一个意念把赵玉霖送进了混沌珠世界，把他放在中央山脉一座石峰上。
“好美的地方，师尊，这是什么地方？”
赵玉霖看着眼前突然变化，但又美得不像样的环境问道。
陆宸道：“这是为师给你找的修行之地，你先修行，有不懂的问为师，饿了自己找吃的。”
“好的，师尊！”
赵玉霖笑着回答，接着收回目光，原地盘腿坐下，潜心修行天魂经。
见此情形，陆宸撤去内世界感知，将修为重新压制在三重武圣境，又收起各种阵法。
刷！
下一刻，陆宸原地消失，朝着城中奔去。
回到城中，陆宸直奔珍宝阁的传送大厅。
“这……”
当陆宸来到珍宝阁时，陆宸有点傻眼。
此时珍宝阁不仅传送大厅，就连传送厅外面周围两里的区域都挤满了等着排队的人。
不说多，十几万人肯定是有的。
毫不夸张的说，如果规规矩矩的排队，这么多人，估计没个几天都走不了。
简单一问，传送费也涨到了天上。
在和平时期，界与界之间传送，只要是四个界以内都是五千块下品灵晶一个单程。
然而，此时从此地传送到隔壁界每人就要六千灵晶，每远一个界增加五千灵晶。

若是横跨四个界，单人单程的费用就从五千涨到了一万六千块灵晶，多了一万一。
不过，即便这样，大家也只能乘坐，因为通过其它途径赶路实在是太慢了。
在这种魔族随时可能跨越海洋杀到这里来的节骨眼上，所有人都不敢浪费时间。
陆宸拉着一个前面排队的中年男子问道：“道友，除了这么排队，有更快的途径吗？”
这个男子看着四十多岁的模样，武道六重武王境，身边还站着五个人，两男三女。
content_en:
Although Zhao Yulin's soul power is very weak, his understanding is very high.
In less than a quarter of an hour, he, who had never used a storage ring before, saw the space inside the storage ring and shouted excitedly: "Master, I saw what you gave me."
"Try to take it out with your mind."
Lu Chen said.
"Okay!"
Zhao Yulin said obediently and tried again.
After a while, he took out some small things, but he couldn't take out those things that weighed one or two kilograms.
Zhao Yulin withdrew his senses and asked puzzledly: "Master, why can't I take out those big things?"
"Because your soul power is too weak."
Lu Chen said.
"Then how can my disciple improve his soul power?"
Zhao Yulin asked.
"Practice the Soul Technique!"
With that said, Lu Chen handed Zhao Yulin the Heavenly Soul Sutra, the Physical Sutra and a Cangling-level skill called the Fighting Holy Technique.
As a ray of light entered Zhao Yulin's sea of ​​consciousness, Zhao Yulin quickly thought of these three techniques in his mind.
"The Heavenly Soul Sutra, the Physical Sutra, and the Holy Technique of Fighting!"
Zhao Yulin murmured to himself, completely attracted.
Lu Chen said: "Xiao Lin, in the next time, you will use the resources given to you by my master to improve your soul power first."
Zhao Yulin said: "Master, why don't you improve your martial arts first?"
Lu Chen smiled and said: "Improve your soul power first, let go of your martial arts, and with your master here, no one can hurt you in a short period of time."
"Okay!"
Zhao Yulin responded with a smile.
Afterwards, Lu Chen sent Zhao Yulin into the Chaos Pearl World with a thought and placed him on a stone peak in the Central Mountain Range.
"What a beautiful place, Master, what kind of place is this?"
Zhao Yulin asked as he looked at the suddenly changed but unattractive environment in front of him.
Lu Chen said: "This is the training place that my teacher has found for you. You practice first. If you don't understand anything, ask your teacher. If you are hungry, you can find food by yourself."
"Okay, Master!"
Zhao Yulin answered with a smile, then withdrew his gaze, sat down cross-legged, and concentrated on practicing the Heavenly Soul Sutra.
Seeing this situation, Lu Chen withdrew his inner world perception, suppressed his cultivation to the third level martial saint realm again, and put away various formations.
brush!
The next moment, Lu Chen disappeared on the spot and ran towards the city.
Back in the city, Lu Chen went straight to the teleportation hall of Zhenbao Pavilion.
"This..."
When Lu Chen came to Zhenbao Pavilion, Lu Chen was a little dumbfounded.
At this time, not only the teleportation hall of Zhenbao Pavilion, but also the two-mile area outside the teleportation hall were crowded with people waiting in line.
Not to mention too many, there must be hundreds of thousands of people.
It is no exaggeration to say that if there were so many people queuing up in an orderly manner, they would not be able to leave for several days.
Just a simple question, the transmission fee has also risen to the sky.
In peacetime, a one-way transfer between realms will cost 5,000 low-grade spiritual crystals as long as it is within four realms.
However, at this time, each person required to teleport from here to the next world would need 6,000 spiritual crystals, and an additional 5,000 spiritual crystals would be required for each distant world.
If it crosses the four realms, the one-way fare for one person will increase from 5,000 to 16,000 pieces of spiritual crystal, which is an increase of 11,000 pieces.
However, even so, everyone can only take it because it is too slow to travel by other means.
At this juncture when the demons could cross the ocean and come here at any time, no one dared to waste time.
Lu Chen pulled a middle-aged man who was queuing in front and asked, "Fellow Taoist, besides queuing like this, is there a faster way?"
This man looked to be in his forties and was at the sixth level of martial arts, the Martial King Realm. There were five people standing around him, two men and three women.
